goal: Verify browser-fixture tasks against the local fixture with independent verifiers.
initial_state: fresh Comptrol state directory with browser fixture loaded

tasks.goal: Confirm repeated ensure_state calls reuse the existing session without a page reload.
tasks.final_verifier: each response contains session_id and reload_count is 0

tasks.goal: Navigate a single-page fixture and verify the DOM target updates without full reload.
tasks.final_verifier: response confirms navigation and current_url matches spa.html

tasks.goal: Open a fixture dialog and verify the dialog handler routes the alert correctly.
Stage a file upload in the fixture and verify the staged buffer is non-empty.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains staged: true and buffer_size > 0

tasks.goal: Initiate a fixture download and verify the downloaded bytes match.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains verified: true and bytes_match: true

tasks.goal: Verify that restoring a closed browser group is refused per V5 policy.
tasks.final_verifier: response contains error code indicating refusal

tasks.goal: Verify session reconnect works after a daemon restart.
